hp.submit.headline: Self-service submission
hp.submit.intro: After submission the server assigns an ID (HC-XXXXXX) and computes a SHA256, then injects the ID into the script. Public submissions are kept on the server long-term; private submissions are deleted from the server once approved, and the script is kept only locally. Before submitting you must link a developer email and verify it with an email code; the review result is sent to that email, and the approval email includes a permanent management link (delist / submit updates / switch between public and private at any time).
hp.submit.saved: The numbered script has been saved locally; the ID and hash are still verified online before enabling.
hp.submit.privateNote: Private submissions wait for backend review; the server deletes the file after review.
hp.submit.emailPlaceholder: Used to receive the code / review result / permanent management link
hp.submit.codePlaceholder: Check your email and enter the 6-digit code
hp.submit.codeSent: Code sent, valid for {n} minutes. Check your inbox (including spam).
hp.submit.missingMeta: The script is missing its metadata block <!--@hcpage { … } -->, so the server cannot inject an ID. Please complete it before submitting.

hp.gate.subtitle.externals: Network access is allowed only after you confirm

hp.gate.minLauncher: This script requires launcher version {min} or higher; the current version is {current}
hp.gate.externalsTitle: The following external addresses will be accessed ({n})
hp.gate.externalsNote: Allowing only relaxes network access (connect-src / img-src); the script still runs in a sandbox with no same-origin and no local file access.
hp.gate.confirmNote: This script has no server-side ID, so its hash cannot be verified online. Local static checks passed (no dangerous behavior such as deleting files, formatting, or downloading executables was found),  but the author and content source cannot be confirmed. The first run requires your confirmation; confirmation is invalidated automatically once the script content changes.
hp.sec.aria: Homepage script disabled by security policy
hp.sec.title: This custom homepage was disabled immediately
hp.sec.subtitle: Dangerous code was detected while the script was running; it was blocked and the built-in UI restored
hp.sec.note1: If behaviors such as deleting / modifying files, formatting disks, or disguised (obfuscated) code appear at runtime, the homepage is disabled immediately and blocked permanently. The block is not lifted by changing the script content: check the script yourself in Homepage → Script folder, and once you are sure, delete and re-import it.
hp.sec.note2: To make sure you see this notice, the launcher was switched to system fullscreen (covering the Windows taskbar as well); it returns to its previous window size after you click "Got it".
hp.engine.tsFallback: Homepage security checks are not using the native (Rust) kernel and have fallen back to the built-in implementation; it works but is slower.
